physicalNotes: Radius 0.86 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Carleo et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4515 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.135C/abstract): 598,302 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.949 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Carleo et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-4515 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.135C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5433 +/- 70 K from Carleo et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4515 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.135C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
